    let row := Json.mkObj [("name",toJson declared.name.toString),("previous",toJson prior.toString),("current",toJson n.toString),
      ("proof_identical",toJson (declared.value? true == c.value? true))]
    if sameDeclaration declared c then cachedReplicas := cachedReplicas.push row
    else duplicateOwners := duplicateOwners.push row
   else if !sameDeclaration declared c then
    duplicateOwners := duplicateOwners.push (Json.mkObj [("name",toJson declared.name.toString),("current",toJson n.toString),("reason",toJson "serialized declaration differs from selected owner")])
   owners := owners.insert declared.name n
   let refs := referenceNames c
   for dep in refs do
    edges := edges + 1
    if (env.checked.get.find? dep).isNone then
     dangling := dangling.push (Json.mkObj [("parent",toJson c.name.toString),("missing",toJson dep.toString)])
  let loaderImports := data.imports.map (fun i => i.module.toString)
  let imports := canonicalImports loaderImports
  let importMatch := match expected[n.toString]? with
   | some baseline => imports == baseline
   | none => false
  if !dangling.isEmpty || !duplicateOwners.isEmpty || !importMatch then failed := true
  out.putStrLn (Json.mkObj [("module",toJson n.toString), ("imports",toJson imports),
   ("loader_imports",toJson loaderImports), ("imports_match",toJson importMatch), ("dangling",toJson dangling), ("duplicate_owners",toJson duplicateOwners), ("cached_replicas",toJson cachedReplicas),
   ("declarations",toJson data.constants.size), ("edges",toJson edges)]).compress
 return failed
end NER

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NJZ_Echeck
open NFU_Retarget
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Words := Fin 8 → Nat
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def Canonical (w : Words) := ∀ i,w i<2147483647
def HighZero (w : Words) : Prop := ∀ (i : Fin 8), (4 ≤ i.val) → w i = 0
def decode (w : Words) : Option Words := if Canonical w then some w else none
def step (reply : Option Words) (k : Bool) : Bool :=
 match reply with
 | none => false
 | some w => !k || decide (HighZero w)

/-- Exact scalar verdict transcribed from K006/K007 after parser substitution.
The full native Option/limbs and byte-window observations are retained in the
certificate; this is its Bool projection, not a native parser theorem. -/
def StepCut (reply : Option Words) (k out : Bool) := out=step reply k

theorem step_iff (w : Words) (k : Bool) :
 step (decode w) k=true ↔ Canonical w ∧ (k=true→HighZero w) := by
 unfold step decode
 by_cases canonical : Canonical w
 · rw [if_pos canonical]
   cases k <;> simp [canonical]
 · rw [if_neg canonical]
   simp [canonical]

def words (bs : List U8) : Words := fun i=>
 LPl.Echeck.word ((bs.drop (4*i.val)).take 4)

/-- Exact natural-byte guard, with every rejected and high-nonzero word. -/
theorem chunk_iff (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) :
 LPl.Echeck.chunk bs k=true ↔
 Canonical (words bs) ∧ (k=true→HighZero (words bs)) := by
 unfold LPl.Echeck.chunk
 rw [List.all_eq_true]
 constructor
 · intro all
   constructor
   · intro i
     have h:=all i.val (List.mem_range.mpr i.isLt)
     have pair : decide (words bs i<2147483647)=true ∧
       (!k || decide (i.val<4 ∨ words bs i=0))=true := by simpa [words] using h
     exact of_decide_eq_true pair.1
   · intro hk i large
     have pair : decide (words bs i<2147483647)=true ∧
       (!k || decide (i.val<4 ∨ words bs i=0))=true := by
      simpa [words] using all i.val (List.mem_range.mpr i.isLt)
     have h:=pair.2
     rw [hk] at h
     have hz : i.val<4 ∨ words bs i=0 := by simpa [words] using h
     rcases hz with small|zero
     · omega
     · exact zero
 · rintro ⟨canonical,high⟩ i inside
   have hi : i<8 := List.mem_range.mp inside
   suffices both : decide (words bs ⟨i,hi⟩<2147483647)=true ∧
     (!k || decide (i<4 ∨ words bs ⟨i,hi⟩=0))=true by simpa [words] using both
   refine ⟨by exact decide_eq_true (canonical ⟨i,hi⟩),?_⟩
   cases hk:k with
   | false => rfl
   | true =>
     have h : i<4 ∨ words bs ⟨i,hi⟩=0 := by
      by_cases small:i<4
      · exact Or.inl small
      · exact Or.inr (high hk ⟨i,hi⟩ (by exact Nat.le_of_not_gt small))
     change decide (i < 4 ∨ words bs ⟨i,hi⟩ = 0) = true
     exact decide_eq_true h

theorem step_chunk (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) :
 step (decode (words bs)) k=LPl.Echeck.chunk bs k := by
 apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
 exact (step_iff _ _).trans (chunk_iff _ _).symm

/-- Native one-step verdict at an arbitrary source position after the complete
codec guard is installed on the SAME selected bytes. -/
theorem at_window (bs : List U8) (k : Bool) (i : Nat) (out : Bool)
 (cut : StepCut (decode (words ((bs.drop (32*i)).take 32))) k out) :
 out=LPl_A.Echeck.predicate bs k i := by
 rw [cut,step_chunk,LPl.Echeck.chunk_eq]
 rfl

/-- Retained first-error induction covers all complete chunks, including
ignored incomplete suffixes. This composes local verdicts; it does not assert
that an unreviewed raw extraction equals the source. -/
theorem result (bs : Slice U8) (k out : Bool)
 (trace : LPl.Echeck.Trace bs.val k 0 out) :
 NFU_Retarget.verifier.echeck bs k=
 ok (if out then .Ok () else .Err .Parse) :=
 LPl.Echeck.native_result bs k out trace

/-- Positive model-side root: only reviewed one-iteration cuts are inputs;
the enclosing Result is derived, with no trace/accepted-output premise. -/
theorem root (bs : Slice U8) (k : Bool) (replies : Nat → Bool)
 (cuts : ∀ i,i<bs.val.length/32→
  StepCut (decode (words ((bs.val.drop (32*i)).take 32))) k (replies i)) :
 NFU_Retarget.verifier.echeck bs k=
 ok (if (List.range (bs.val.length/32)).all replies then .Ok () else .Err .Parse) := by
 have verdict : LPl_A.Echeck.loop bs.val k=
   (List.range (bs.val.length/32)).all replies := by
  rw [LPl_A.Echeck.loop_eq_model]
  unfold LPl_Kit_Bytes.chunksValid
  apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
  simp only [List.all_eq_true,List.mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro all i hi
    rw [at_window bs.val k i (replies i) (cuts i hi)]
    exact all i hi
  · intro all i hi
    change LPl_A.Echeck.predicate bs.val k i=true
    rw [←at_window bs.val k i (replies i) (cuts i hi)]
    exact all i hi
 rw [LPl_A.Echeck.shipped_leaf_model,verdict]

namespace NJZ_EmptyTree
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Digest := NJP_CompressionPacket.Digest
abbrev Table := Fin 21 → Digest

def zero : Digest := fun _ => 0#u32
def parent : Digest → Digest → Digest := NJP_CompressionPacket.model
def root : Nat → Digest
 | 0 => zero
 | n+1 => parent (root n) (root n)

def Canonical (x : Digest) := ∀ i,(x i).val<2147483647

theorem parent_canonical (left right : Digest) : Canonical (parent left right) :=
 fun _=>NJP_FieldEncoding.canonical _

theorem root_canonical (n : Nat) : Canonical (root n) := by
 cases n with
 | zero => intro i;change 0<2147483647;omega
 | succ n => exact parent_canonical _ _

/-- Native arbitrary table-window assertion: identical child arguments at
level, reply stored only at level+1, all other cells framed. -/
def StepCut (before after : Table) (level : Fin 20) (reply : Digest) : Prop :=
 ∀ j,after j=if j.val=level.val+1 then reply else before j

/-- Finite source-order chain, not kernel evaluation of twenty Poseidon calls.
Only entered children at SAME current level are instantiated with their model. -/
theorem frame (states : Nat → Table) (initial : ∀ j,states 0 j=zero)
 (cuts : ∀ n (hn : n<20), StepCut (states n) (states (n+1)) ⟨n,hn⟩
   (parent (states n ⟨n,by omega⟩) (states n ⟨n,by omega⟩))) :
 ∀ n,n≤20→∀ j : Fin 21,states n j=if j.val≤n then root j.val else zero := by
 intro n;induction n with
 | zero =>
   intro hn j
   rw [initial]
   by_cases h:j.val≤0
   · have eq:j.val=0:=by omega
     simp only [eq,root,ite_self]
   · rw [if_neg h]
 | succ n ih =>
   intro hn j
   rw [cuts n (by omega) j]
   by_cases h:j.val=n+1
   · rw [if_pos h,ih (by omega),if_pos (show n≤n from le_rfl)]
     rw [h,if_pos (show n+1≤n+1 from le_rfl)]
     rfl
   · rw [if_neg h,ih (by omega)]
     by_cases hj:j.val≤n
     · rw [if_pos hj,if_pos (by omega)]
     · rw [if_neg hj,if_neg (by omega)]

theorem roots (states : Nat → Table) (initial : ∀ j,states 0 j=zero)
 (cuts : ∀ n (hn : n<20), StepCut (states n) (states (n+1)) ⟨n,hn⟩
   (parent (states n ⟨n,by omega⟩) (states n ⟨n,by omega⟩))) :
 ∀ j,states 20 j=root j.val := by
 intro j
 simpa only [if_pos (show j.val≤20 from by omega)] using frame states initial cuts 20 (by omega) j

/-- Domain for every entered compression comes from the same preceding cuts,
not a new canonical-reply or successful-child premise. -/
theorem entered_domain (states : Nat → Table) (initial : ∀ j,states 0 j=zero)
 (cuts : ∀ n (hn : n<20), StepCut (states n) (states (n+1)) ⟨n,hn⟩
   (parent (states n ⟨n,by omega⟩) (states n ⟨n,by omega⟩)))
 (n : Fin 20) : Canonical (states n.val ⟨n.val,by omega⟩) := by
 rw [frame states initial cuts n.val (by omega) _,if_pos (show n.val≤n.val from le_rfl)]
 exact root_canonical _

structure Tree where
 next : U64
 root : Digest
 frontier : Fin 20 → Digest

def empty : Tree := ⟨0#u64,root 20,fun i=>root i.val⟩
def default : Tree := empty

/-- Empty constructor copies the exact indexed table cells and zero cursor. -/
def EmptyCut (table : Table) (out : Tree) : Prop :=
 out.next=0#u64 ∧ out.root=table ⟨20,by omega⟩ ∧
 ∀ i,out.frontier i=table ⟨i.val,by omega⟩

theorem empty_source (table : Table) (cells : ∀ i,table i=root i.val)
 (out : Tree) (cut : EmptyCut table out) : out=empty := by
 cases out with
 | mk next value frontier =>
  rcases cut with ⟨cursor,valueEq,frontierEq⟩
  simp only at cursor valueEq frontierEq
  subst next
  rw [cells] at valueEq
  subst value
  have fs : frontier=(fun i : Fin 20=>root i.val) := by
   funext i;rw [frontierEq,cells]
  rw [fs]
  rfl

/-- Compose the empty constructor with its CLOSED-candidate child chain;
the table equality and every entered child domain are internally derived. -/
theorem empty_root (states : Nat → Table) (initial : ∀ j,states 0 j=zero)
 (cuts : ∀ n (hn : n<20), StepCut (states n) (states (n+1)) ⟨n,hn⟩
   (parent (states n ⟨n,by omega⟩) (states n ⟨n,by omega⟩)))
 (out : Tree) (constructor : EmptyCut (states 20) out) :
 out=empty ∧ ∀ n : Fin 20,Canonical (states n.val ⟨n.val,by omega⟩) :=
 ⟨empty_source _ (roots states initial cuts) out constructor,
  entered_domain states initial cuts⟩

/-- Default's sole child reply is returned unchanged, on every field. -/
def DefaultCut (reply out : Tree) : Prop := out=reply

theorem default_root (states : Nat → Table) (initial : ∀ j,states 0 j=zero)
 (cuts : ∀ n (hn : n<20), StepCut (states n) (states (n+1)) ⟨n,hn⟩
   (parent (states n ⟨n,by omega⟩) (states n ⟨n,by omega⟩)))
 (child out : Tree) (constructor : EmptyCut (states 20) child)
 (returnCut : DefaultCut child out) : out=default := by
 have childResult := (empty_root states initial cuts child constructor).1
 exact returnCut.trans childResult

/-- Child's exact seeded permutation/projection reply, as CLOSED TX1:305. -/
def reply (left right : Digest) : Digest := fun i=>
 NJP_PermutationPacket.model (NJE_CompressSeed.seed left right) ⟨i.val,by omega⟩

/-- Transcription of NJZ_native::tree_parent: SAME left/right argument values,
full arbitrary digest reply, one child call and immutable inputs. -/
structure Cut (left right seenLeft seenRight returned out : Digest) (calls : Nat) : Prop where
 left : seenLeft=left
 right : seenRight=right
 output : out=returned
 count : calls=1

/-- The CLOSED compression theorem is instantiated internally at the SAME
arguments; its entire Result is used, not a child-success/root-output premise. -/
theorem source (left right seenLeft seenRight out : Digest) (calls : Nat)
 (hl : Canonical left) (hr : Canonical right)
 (cut : Cut left right seenLeft seenRight (reply seenLeft seenRight) out calls) :
 out=parent left right ∧ calls=1 ∧ Canonical out := by
 have child := NJP_CompressionPacket.TX1_305 left right hl hr
  (NJE_CompressSeed.seed left right) (reply left right) 1
  {seed:=rfl,call_count:=rfl,output:=fun _=>rfl}
 have value : out=parent left right := by
  rw [cut.output,cut.left,cut.right]
  exact child.1
 exact ⟨value,cut.count,by rw [value];exact parent_canonical left right⟩

import NJC_ValidateResult
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NJZ_Validator
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open NJC_ValidateResult
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Every entered suffix element is in range and absent from its actual prefix. -/
theorem members (pre tail : List U32) (valid : ValidFrom pre tail)
 (x : U32) (member : x∈tail) : x.val<262144 ∧ x∉pre := by
 induction tail generalizing pre with
 | nil => cases member
 | cons y ys ih =>
  rcases valid with ⟨small,absent,rest⟩
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same|later
  · subst x;exact ⟨small,absent⟩
  · obtain ⟨range,notPrefix⟩ := ih (pre++[y]) rest later
    exact ⟨range,fun earlier=>notPrefix (List.mem_append_left _ earlier)⟩

theorem unique (pre tail : List U32) (valid : ValidFrom pre tail) : tail.Nodup := by
 induction tail generalizing pre with
 | nil => exact List.nodup_nil
 | cons y ys ih =>
  rcases valid with ⟨small,absent,rest⟩
  apply List.nodup_cons.mpr
  refine ⟨?_,ih (pre++[y]) rest⟩
  intro later
  have impossible := (members (pre++[y]) ys rest y later).2
  exact impossible (List.mem_append_right _ (by simp only [List.mem_singleton]))

/-- Complete source reply, including every rejected array, with domain
properties derived internally from its classification. No successful-child,
uniqueness, or caller-output premise is a root input. -/
theorem source (queries : Array U32 22#usize) :
 NJC_ValidateEmission.verifier.validate_checkpoint_queries queries=
 ok (if ValidFrom [] queries.val then core.result.Result.Ok ()
     else core.result.Result.Err NID_ResumeEmission.verifier.Error.Checkpoint) ∧
 (ValidFrom [] queries.val →
  (∀ x∈queries.val,x.val<262144) ∧ queries.val.Nodup) := by
 refine ⟨NJC_ValidateResult.source queries,?_⟩
 intro valid
 exact ⟨fun x hx=>(members [] queries.val valid x hx).1,unique [] queries.val valid⟩

 (weights : Slice aspis_core.field.QM31) (size : weights.val.length=64)
 (states : Nat → alloc.vec.Vec Row)
 (cuts : NJC_FilledClause.reserved reservation=true → ∀ i, i<64 →

 Port3_QueryInstall.result
   (Port3_NativePendingBody.extracted (NJR_ReservationRaw.filled reservation) weights)=
 if NJC_FilledClause.reserved reservation then
  ok (.Ok (⟨states 64,0#usize⟩ : verifier.BatchedWeights)) else ok (.Err .Allocation) := by
 rw [NJR_ReservationRaw.pending]
 exact NJJ_Pending.source (NJC_FilledClause.reserved reservation) weights size states cuts

is independent of every unselected row and terms, as NJJ_Value.projection proves. -/
theorem value_source (b : S8Kani2MutableValue.F.BW) (i : Usize)
 (bound : i.val<b.raw.length) :
 ∃ row : S8OwnedP6ValueModel.Row, b.raw.val[i.val]?=some row ∧
 S8Kani2MutableValue.F.value b i=ok
  (S8Kani2FinishReferenceJoin.toFinish (S8OwnedP6Finish.modelValue row)) :=
 NJJ_Value.source b i bound

/-- Every full mutable store/frame cut is instantiated with the value model
on the SAME raw index; finite induction identifies all64 destination cells.
The immutable receiver clauses remain explicit in each cut. -/
theorem finish_source (b : VTop_Stages.verifier.BatchedWeights)
 (old : Slice VTop_Stages.aspis_core.field.QM31)
 (rawSize : b.raw.val.length=64) (oldSize : old.val.length=64)
 (states : Nat → List VTop_Stages.aspis_core.field.QM31)
 (initial : states 0=old.val)
 (cuts : ∀ i,i<64→∃ row, b.raw.val[i]?=some row ∧
  NJR_Cuts.flushStep b.raw.val b.raw.val b.terms b.terms
   (states i) (states (i+1)) i (NJJ_Flush.cell row)) :
 Port3_FlushInstall.flush b old=ok (NJJ_Flush.output b) ∧
 states 64=(NJJ_Flush.output b).val ∧
 (∀ q∈states 64,Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical q) := by
 have sizes : ∀ n,n≤64→(states n).length=64 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro _;rw [initial];exact oldSize
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hn
    obtain ⟨row,read,cut⟩:=cuts n (by omega)
    rw [cut.2.2.1]
    exact ih (by omega)
 apply NJR_FlushComposition.source b old rawSize oldSize states sizes
 intro i hi j hj
 obtain ⟨row,read,cut⟩ := cuts i hi
 rw [cut.2.2.2 j (by rw [sizes i (by omega)];exact hj),read]
 rfl
